about: Values taken from the UNCHANGED v776 build (commit 78aa291, source dev/tt.jsx as released in v776) by running TT_PROBE=1 node tests116.js on it, before any change for the All grammar list: hashes of the Japanese Words list (Grammar review part open and closed, and the Known grammar row opened), the Grammar for this track preview, the plan screen, the writer prompt block, the gate context, the plan, the track summary, the export, the GRAMMAR IN THIS TRACK screen and the rating card, for five states (n32 = the real learner: 32 grammar points introduced earlier and never rated, 150 known words; n3 = 3 points waiting for a rating beside rated ones; n5 = exactly 5 waiting; n0 = a blank grammar store; nt = a store holding records shaped as a tick leaves them, which v776 reads as plain known and plain NEW points), the Thai / Mandarin / Cantonese Words lists with the 32 points in the grammar store, and the code of the three generator screens, the Japanese generator and the Words list. tests116.js F1 (switch off) and F2 (switch on, with the new part cut out of the Words list) compare the new build to these.
